name: Truehome Desk
description:
Truehome is an Irish property platform. Truehome Desk connects an estate agent's desk to Claude: the listings they manage, the buyers enquiring, the viewings booked, and the offers on the table.

Ask what came in overnight and get a straight answer. Check where a property stands against its reserve and the seller's goal. See which viewing slots still have room and who is waiting on a reply. Draft a listing, add a note to a property, record an offer, or answer a buyer, without opening the dashboard.

Four views render inline rather than as raw text: your listings as photo cards with price, status and BER rating, your portfolio against list, reserve, goal and highest offer, your enquiries with unread counts, and your viewing diary.

Anything that changes data is deliberately two steps. The tool returns a summary of exactly what it will do plus a confirmation token, and does nothing until you approve it. Sending a message to a buyer, publishing a listing, changing a listing's status, responding to a viewing request, revoking a review link and inviting a colleague all work this way.

Truehome Desk reads and writes only the agent's own branch data, scoped at consent to reading, drafting and acting. It reaches nothing outside Truehome.

You need a Truehome agent account. Sign up at truehome.ie.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Truehome Desk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Truehome Desk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.truehome.ie/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Truehome Desk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Truehome Desk lists 31 MCP tools, including add_listing_note, create_listing, create_review_link, create_viewing_slot, get_activity_since, get_auction_close_link, get_branch, get_conversation, get_listing, get_my_profile, get_portfolio_summary, and invite_staff.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Truehome Desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Truehome Desk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Truehome Desk MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Truehome Desk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Truehome Desk is developed by Truehome. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
